title: [finding] the landing flow has no legal state for the undraft route's 429 — a seat that hits it can only escalate or invent a retry cadence, while the 429 body names the exact instant to wait for
body:
**Class (b)** — a prohibition without a permitted action. Filed by the skills seat from the #18601 round (PR #18741), the dev's `open_questions[0]` ruled A by the seat. ⛔ Bare `finding`; lane, type and priority are triage's.

## The reading

- `platform-readings.md` (PR #18741, landing) now records at :48–:49 that the ccr undraft route `POST …/pulls/{n}/ccr/ready_for_review` draws on the session credential's hourly GraphQL pool and answers 429 with a zero-byte write when it is spent, that the 429 body's `resets at` instant is the only readable signal, and that the body carries its own instruction ⛔ 重置前不重试; and at :163 that a full `/rate_limit` graphql balance is ⛔ not clearance for the undraft act (same-minute evidence: 10000 / 10000 while the route answered 429).
- What no lane text says: what an arming run IS when it meets that 429. `SKILL.md` 〈入队与落地〉 names ready → auto-merge → queue → `merged_at`; the standing rules forbid busy-polling and blind retries. ⇒ a seat that hits the 429 has a fact, a prohibition, and no declared outcome — it must either report the landing as blocked (it is not; it is dated) or pick a cadence on its own (the thing the rules forbid). Measured cost on PR #18598: 27 minutes with no readable warning before the act, per #18601.

## Suggested shape (⛔ not a prescription)

One row of lane text in `SKILL.md` 〈入队与落地〉 (or `references/rest-channel.md` if the seat prefers the fact-adjacent home): 「undraft 撞 429 ⇒ 落地进入『等 `resets at`』态:记该时刻于卡,到点一次重试;⛔ 不报阻塞、不自定节奏」 — so a named wait is an accepted, recorded outcome of an arming run. ⚠️ `SKILL.md` is at 812 / 812; the row is paid by a deletion, and it sits in the SKILL.md serial queue behind PR #18666 / #18679 / #18536.

## Not measured

Whether a `/rate_limit`-red graphql window predicts a ccr 429 at all (the two pools are not the same pool — #18601). That predicate deserves its own measurement card; it should not block the state's existence.
